author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at Sony's official response to nuking our ownership of content on their platform. Their response is frankly aggravating and it shows in my opinion they haven't considered how little value they provide and why people won't be paying insane premiums for what they do in the future. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: So Sony Finally Responded...
